historicalDefectLedger.originalIssue: Stem asked for reading of dictionary form 貸す but options offered polite past かしました.
historicalDefectLedger.resolution: Adopted standard JLPT bracketed format 友達に日本語の辞書を【貸しました】 with options かしました, かりました, etc.

historicalDefectLedger.originalIssue: Stem asked for reading of dictionary form 拾う but key was past polite ひろいました.
historicalDefectLedger.resolution: Adopted standard JLPT bracketed format 道で鍵を【拾いました】 with options ひろいました, あつめました, etc.

historicalDefectLedger.originalIssue: Stem asked for reading of dictionary form 送る but key was past polite おくりました.
historicalDefectLedger.resolution: Adopted standard JLPT bracketed format 家族に荷物を【送りました】 with options おくりました, とどけました, etc.

historicalDefectLedger.originalIssue: Both ようにしています and ことにしています were defensible in context.
historicalDefectLedger.resolution: Replaced distractor ことに with ために, ensuring unique grammatical fit for ように.

historicalDefectLedger.originalIssue: Proposed chunk permutation resulted in incoherent juxtaposition (おく followed by 朝慌てて).
historicalDefectLedger.resolution: Redesigned sentence to 朝慌てて探すことがないように夜のうちに服を準備しておきます with clear slot order and explicit assembledSentence.

historicalDefectLedger.originalIssue: Previous version used cyclic ABCD target allocation and a hardcoded lookup dictionary in independent_blind_solver.
historicalDefectLedger.resolution: Eliminated hardcoded blind solver, reordered choices using seed-clean-audit seeded shuffle, marked bank INDEPENDENT_QA_PENDING, and prepared blind review dataset for genuine subagent evaluation.

note: Immutable audit history preserving all detected defects and their verified resolutions.
